observations: Half-step samples 0.5, 8.5 and 10 were successfully written and read back.
Zero and values above 10 were rejected. Off-grid values such as 8.6 were rejected with a diagnostic naming multiples of 0.50.

Quarter-step values could receive successful acknowledgements while new entries remained absent during bounded readback. Updates to existing entries at 0.75, 8.25 and 8.75 were observed in the rated list.
An update from 8.5 to 0.25 was acknowledged but bounded readback remained at 8.5.
Readback can lag: a successful update may initially return the previous rating.
Guest movie account_states returned HTTP 401/code 3 even with a valid guest credential that succeeded for rating writes and list reads.
After successful DELETE/code 13, rated-list reads returned HTTP 404/code 34, matching the fresh empty guest baseline. This is not a general rule that 404 means unrated.
rating.conclusion: The observed guest API does not establish a uniform quarter-step write contract. Half-step mapping is a candidate for the complete design, but ordinary user-session create/update/readback, private list access and watchlist effects remain unverified.
